card.name: Linking words before depression or bipolar terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "with" after "patients" and "the" after "may be", just before a mood disorder term like MDD or bipolar disorder. Seen in antidepressant label text.

modes.label: patients with + disorder
modes.description: The word "with" right after a patient group, before a depression or mania diagnosis.

modes.description: The word "the" in the bipolar screening warning, before "initial presentation".
